user.title: Hapo
user.description: Set up Hapo to calculate room presence, resident sleep and home modes. Configure sources and rules in the Hapo sidebar panel.

room_override.name: Set room presence override
room_override.description: Force a room occupied or clear, or resume automatic calculation.

value.name: Value
value.description: The requested state or stable mode key.

target_id.name: Hapo identifier
target_id.description: Stable room or resident ID displayed in the Hapo panel, not an entity ID.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Override duration in seconds. Zero keeps the override until you resume automatic operation.

home_override.name: Set home mode override
home_override.description: Choose a stable home mode key, or auto to resume rules. This does not change presence facts.

value.name: Value
value.description: The requested state or stable mode key.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Override duration in seconds. Zero keeps the override until you resume automatic operation.

sleep.name: Set resident sleep
sleep.description: Put a resident to sleep, wake them up, or release manual control. A confirmed departure clears manual sleep.

value.name: Value
value.description: The requested state or stable mode key.

target_id.name: Hapo identifier
target_id.description: Stable room or resident ID displayed in the Hapo panel, not an entity ID.

guests.name: Set guest presence
guests.description: Declare guests present even when all tracked residents are away.

value.name: Value
value.description: The requested state or stable mode key.
